integrity: All mathematical claims refer to the displayed four transition rates. No independent validation, external certification, or publication claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Applies to fixed finite mutation-free continuous-time Markov chains with integer resource stocks; ecological extinction occurs almost surely and conditional long-time survival describes rare trajectories, not permanent sustainability or a uniform large-system limit.
title: A sharp resource-lattice threshold for cooperation among long-lived stochastic commons
